title: Verify, request the exact human action, then resume
when: A declared site is signed out or an exploratory mission hits auth
need: Verify first; authorize opens only expired sites. Human supplies personal credentials; unreachable probes need technical repair. Sign-in pauses automated browsers on that machine until windows close. From the connected workstation, --machine reads declarations and opens sign-in on the registered Test Machine GUI, without a control-plane connection there. Unrouted hosts still receive nonsecret declarations locally; live identity store survives reset. Required desktop-browser extension: browser authorize must also check Test Machine Linux Chromium and macOS Safari sign-ins, open only expired sites, name the account, and keep desktop sign-ins live through reset outside goldens. Combined authorization requires --machine NAME --desktop-browser; --machine alone keeps the existing remote automation-only behavior. The revised producer contract is not yet a committed verified successor; full CI, merge, real-host and release proof remain pending.
surface: Installed browser identities reference and authorize help; successor Pack Linux procedure and macOS entry pointer to the complete browser-identities procedure.
gap: The unreleased successor repairs the portable installed reference and per-OS private-policy audience boundary in source. Released-target and actual receiving/sign-in proof remain pending. The initial native-inclusion candidate failed an unchanged remote consumer; the explicit desktop opt-in repair awaits its corrective commit, new full CI, merge and real-host/released proof.
review: Remote command, lease ownership, settings validation, quoting, OS GUI helpers and post-window outcome forwarding have source regression tests; live operator sign-in proof remains pending. Source-only successor documentation preserves all six macOS identity steps in browser-identities.md and keeps a mandatory macOS entry link. The unmerged Linux reset correction 5a4b84c0d7565f38cc2308df25950fd76d4fef0e has producer-reported 29 targeted PASS and CI run 39040788218 PASS, QA requirement 50631 artifact 36759; no real reset or released delivery is proved. Historical authorize commit 31b0cfaf30d303c729d936d49e178fa65e6faeed was an unmerged candidate with 53 focused checks and ruff PASS, but full CI run 39042681883 FAILED an unchanged automation-only remote-route consumer. The producer revised the contract in uncommitted source: --machine NAME --desktop-browser explicitly opts into automation then native Linux snap Chromium/macOS Safari in the same GUI process; --machine without that flag remains automation-only. Producer reports 70 focused checks PASS including that unchanged consumer. Exact corrective commit, new full CI, merge, real-host sign-in/reset and released delivery remain pending. Prior automatic native inclusion and native-only flag teaching are superseded.
recipes: yoke projects capability-settings get --project P --cap-type browser-control --json
